name: capped_dta_deduction_minimum_equity_injection
question_template: Apply only this fictional scenario-local capital policy. A bank has gross common equity of {GROSS_EQUITY} USD million, intangible assets of {INTANGIBLES} USD million and deferred tax assets of {DTA} USD million. Intangibles are deducted in full. Deferred tax assets are deducted only to the extent they exceed {CAP_PCT} percent of gross common equity net of intangibles; this deduction is never negative. Net common equity is gross common equity minus both deductions. Current risk-weighted assets are {RWA} USD million and the leverage exposure measure is {EXPOSURE} USD million. Net common equity must be at least {RWA_MIN_PCT} percent of risk-weighted assets and at least {LEV_MIN_PCT} percent of the exposure measure, both inclusive. The bank may inject new common equity X of at least zero: X adds to gross common equity (so the deferred tax threshold is recomputed on the enlarged equity), adds 20 percent of X to risk-weighted assets, and adds X in full to the exposure measure. Find the smallest X in USD million that satisfies both constraints simultaneously. Along the way report net common equity before injection, the deferred tax deduction before injection, and the binding constraint: rwa, leverage, or none when no injection is needed (if both constraints require the same positive X, report rwa).

slots.description: Net common equity before any injection after both deductions.
Deferred tax deduction before any injection.
Which constraint determines the minimum injection.

program:
from fractions import Fraction

def solve():
    G = Fraction(P["GROSS_EQUITY"])
    I = Fraction(P["INTANGIBLES"])
    D = Fraction(P["DTA"])
    c = Fraction(P["CAP_PCT"]) / 100
    rwa0 = Fraction(P["RWA"])
    exp0 = Fraction(P["EXPOSURE"])
    r = Fraction(P["RWA_MIN_PCT"]) / 100
    l = Fraction(P["LEV_MIN_PCT"]) / 100
    w = Fraction(20, 100)

    net0 = G - I
    ded0 = max(Fraction(0), D - c * net0)
    cet1_0 = net0 - ded0

    # CET1(X) = min(net0 + X, (1+c)(net0 + X) - D); both pieces increasing in X.
    # Constraint CET1(X) >= k*(base + s*X) holds iff X >= max(root_A, root_B).
    def required(k, base, s):
        xa = (k * base + D - (1 + c) * net0) / ((1 + c) - k * s)
        xb = (k * base - net0) / (1 - k * s)
        return max(xa, xb)

    x_rwa = required(r, rwa0, w)
    x_lev = required(l, exp0, Fraction(1))
    x_min = max(Fraction(0), x_rwa, x_lev)

    if x_min == 0:
        binding = "none"
    elif x_rwa >= x_lev:
        binding = "rwa"
    else:
        binding = "leverage"

    return {
        "final": x_min,
        "initial_net_equity_usd_million": cet1_0,
        "initial_dta_deduction_usd_million": ded0,
        "binding_constraint": binding,
    }
